lines: Trying to control everything does not mean you are safe.
You can release some tension without chaos appearing.
Some people plan every detail, but they still feel overwhelmed.
Your mind will wander when you try to micromanage thoughts.
Small habits work better when you give them space to breathe.
Focus sharpens when you accept a few uncertainties.
Emotions settle when you stop forcing them into boxes.
Peace grows when you trust yourself to handle what comes.
Follow for more daily psychology about your mind and habits.
